title: Real-time deep neural network detects early gastric cancer on endoscopy
summary: A deep convolutional neural network trained on 45,240 endoscopic images from 1,364 patients detected early gastric cancer with AUC 0.887-0.940, accuracy 85.1%-91.2%, sensitivity 85.9%-95.5% and specificity 81.7%-90.3% in validation data. An external set of 1,514 images from three hospitals was used, it outperformed endoscopists and improved their readings, and it processed endoscopy video in real time. The study is retrospective and the authors call for multicentre prospective validation.
ai_technology: Real-time deep convolutional neural network (DCNN) for lesion detection on endoscopic images and video
organization: Nanjing Drum Tower Hospital; Nanjing University

evidence.tested: Diagnostic performance was compared with endoscopists, with and without system reference, on validation, external and video data.
evidence.unknown: Prospective clinical performance is unknown. Abstract-based; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: A DCNN classified endoscopic images and video frames for early gastric cancer.
